data.name: Repair to pot holes (75mm B.M)

data.name: Built-Up-Spray Grout
data.description: Providing, laying and rolling of built-up-spray grout layer over prepared base consisting of a two-layer composite construction of compacted crushed coarse aggregates using motor grader for aggregates key stone chips spreader may be used with application of bituminous binder after each layer, and with key aggregates placed on top of the second layer to serve as a Base conforming to the line, grades and cross-section specified, the compacted layer thickness being 75 mm.

data.name: Repair of Pot Holes, Patch Repair
data.description: Providing, laying and rolling of built-up-spray grout layer over prepared base consisting of composite construction of compacted crushed coarse aggregates and key stone chips with application of bituminous binder after each layer, and with key aggregates placed on top of the final layer to serve as a Base conforming to the line, grades and cross-section specified, (number of layers of coarse aggregate shall be as per site requirement).

data.name: PST based ready mix compound (25mm)
data.description: Providing and Laying Pressure Sensitive Technology (PST) based ready mix compound for repair potholes, manufactured from aggregates of 4-12 mm, treated with special grade bitumen, Pressure Sensitive Polymer( PSP) and Cross Linking Chemical (CLC) agents etc, technically evaluated for repairs on bitumenous/concrete surfaces, confirming to CRRI and IRC norms for pressure sensitive polymer products for repairs of Potholes on road/ Pavements, havinfg upto 25mm thick layer on base of compacted aggregates (Crusher Brocken) of 50mm thickness including labours, material, tools and tampering etc complete.

data.name: PST based ready mix compound (treated)
data.description: Providing and laying Pressure Sensitive Technology (PST) based ready mix compound for repairing potholes, manufactured from aggregates of 4-12mm, treated compound having mix of bituminous antistriping compound, stabilizer, Pressure Sensitive Polymer and water repellent compound like oil soluble polyacid etc. having good consistency for laying, technically evaluated for repairs on bituminous/concrete surface confirming to CRRI and IRC norms for pressure sensitive polymer products for repairs fo potholes on road/ pavement having upto 25mm thick ready thickness including labours, material, tools and tampering etc. complete. (Undertaking shall be taken from the supplier before starting the work)

data.name: 50 mm thick Full grout bituminous treatment
data.description: Providing 50 mm thick Full grout bituminous treatment including supplying all materials, prepairing the exisisting road surface, applying tack coat @ 0.735 kg/sqm and laying the required thickness of metal layer, heating and spraying bitumen of specified Grade at the rate of 5.00 kg/sqm, spreading chips and laying seal coat of specified Grade of bitumen of 1.70 Kg/sqm and compacting, making the surface good etc. complete (For only Patch Repair works / For Road work) (VG-30 bulk bitumen rates are considered to arrive at rates)

data.name: 50 mm thick semi grout bituminous treatment
data.description: Providing 50 mm thick semi grout bituminous treatment including supplying all materials, prepairing the exisisting road surface, applying tack coat @ 0.735 kg/sqm and laying the required thickness of metal layer, heating and spraying bitumen of specified Grade at the rate of 2.75 kg / sqm, spreading chips and laying seal coat of specified Grade of bitumen of 1.25 Kg/sqm and compacting, making the surface good etc. complete (For only Patch Repair works / For Road work) (VG-30 bulk bitumen rates are considered to arrive at rates)

data.name: Pot Hole filling with Jet PatcherUpto 50mm
data.description: Pot Hole filling with Jet Patcher-Repairs to potholes 50 mm upto 100 mm by using semidense bituminous concrete in cold mix by using emulsion including making the potholes /patches in regular shape and size. Removing loose pockets, dewatering in potholes, tack coats of 25 Kilogram/10 Sq.Mt. with RS1 emulsion etc.by use of advanced jetpatching technolgy machine of approved make and specification having capacity 5.50 TO 8.00 cubic meters with auxillary engine with direct drive to heavy duty blower, Rotary Positive Displacement Blower with direct drive and separate airline silencer. data.description: Repair to cement concrete road by providing laying & Fixing mortar- based patch master & Liquid rapid harding chemical including cleaning of concrete surface and applying of special bounding liquid.

data.name: Repair of joint Grooves with Epoxy Mortar
data.description: Repair of spalled joint grooves of contraction joints, construction joint, longitudinal joints and expansion joints in concrete pavements using epoxy mortar or epoxy concrete.

data.name: Repair of old Joints Sealant
data.description: Removal of existing sealant and re-sealing of contraction, construction longitudinal or expansion joints in concrete pavement with fresh sealant material

data.name: Removing all loose concrete
data.description: Removing all loose concrete which is detached from the substrate, by using a mechanical wire brush, complete with removing dust by compressed air and dampening the surface with water without puddles.

data.name: Applying one coat of bonding material
data.description: Applying one coat of bonding material complying to ASTM C881 Type-2, Grade-2, class-C like Anchorex EPB or equivalent on the cleaned substrate by spray/roller @ 10 sq m per ltr

data.name: Mixing and applying of 30mm thickness Repair material
data.description: Mixing and applying of 30mm thickness Repair material confirming to IRC SP 83-2018 clause 12.1.2.a and 12.1.4 an ultra fast strength concrete repair mortar which does not require external water curing and attains compressive strength of 40N/mm2 @ 5 hours from placing as per IS 516 such as Strextra EFS 4, or equivelent after diluting it with 10mm aggregates at a proportion of 1:0:5 (concrete 10mm aggregates); mixing and placing the mortar as per manufactures data sheet over the prepared surface of the pavement, complete along strengthening, no water curing and opening the road to traffic within 5-6 hours of placing(the last bag of mortar)

data.name: Providing and applying a dry-shake surface non- metallic floor
data.description: Providing and applying a dry-shake surface non- metallic floor surface hardner of mohs hardness 6 or more like Tapcrete 333 or equivelent over the repair mortar Strextra R-20 or equivalt while the mortar is still green that means the mortar has not achieved final set, consumption @ 7kg/sq.m. applied as per manufactures data sheet, inclusive with finishing material labour.

data.name: Crack stitching with inclined tie bar (cross Stitching)
data.description: Crack stitching with inclined tie bar (cross Stitching) used for cracks in reasonably good condition in order to arrest movement of slab and slabs pieces by making primer verticals holes,, alternative inclined hole, cleaning the hole through oil free compressor and filled with epoxy resin in enough quality that will coat HYSD bar confirming IS 1786 of 12 mm dia in every hole also groone shall be made along with line cracks display spalling and filled with a low viscocity resin or fire epoxy mortar following the method specified IRC SP 83:2008.

data.name: Stapling
data.description: Crack stitching with V-bars (Stapling) to be used for cracks in reasonably good condition in order to arrest movement of slabs and slab pieces by making the position of vertical holes of dia 30 mm at a distance of 228 mm form the crack at spacing of 600 mm center to center, drilling holes, Slit removing, Devris cleaning from the holes, roughen the sites of hole and slit by sand blasting, sand paper. Insert the steel bar (FE 500), fill the holes and silt with epoxy mortar (1:3 epoxy: sand) up to 10mm above the top surface of steel bar. Filling with non-shrinkable concrete or any other equivalent material may be filled up to the top level of PQ2 and fill the sides of the groove with low visco sity epoxy following the IRC SP 83:2018.

data.name: Rainwater Harvesting System
data.description: Rainwater Harvesting System Involving construction of roadside rainwater harvesting system involves the development of percolation tanks across the basin using earthen structures. Recharge tank inner side of diameter 1.5 metre including excavation upto 2.50 m depth and placing perforated NP4 1500 mm dia. pipe 3.00 m length, above 0.5 m ground level 150 mm diameter bore will be drilled up to 15.00 meter the ground water table or the sand layer, whichever is higher. Additionally, a 100 mm diameter perforated PVC pipe will be installed up to RCC cover and to the bore depth to facilitate water infiltration. Inside the percolation tank, a recharge zone will be prepared with multiple filtration layers to enhance groundwater recharge which shall be consist of 1. Stone Boulder Layer: (5 cm to 20 cm in size) 1 m height forming the base. 2. Gravel Layer: (5 mm to 10 mm in size) 0.5 m height placed over the boulder layer. 3. Brick Bats Layer: Positioned above the gravel layer to aid filtration 0.5 m height. 4. Coarse Sand Layer: (1.5 mm to 2 mm in size) 0.50 m height forming the topmost layer for improved filtration efficiency. Precast R.C.C. perforated drain covers Providing and fixing factory made precast RCC perforated drain covers, having concrete of strength not less than M-25, of size 2.00 m dia., including reinforcement and with 8 mm dia four no longitudinal and 9 nos cross sectional T.M.T. Hoop bars, including providing50 mm dia perforations @ 100 to 125 mm c/c, including providing edge binding with M.S. flats of size 50 mmx1.6 mm complete, recharge tank cover all around Gabion wall upto 0.6 m width and 0.5 m height all as per direction of Engineer-in- Charge. To effectively collect and channel rainwater, the ditch and furrow method will be implemented across the basin, directing water toward the percolation pit for efficient groundwater recharge.
